_note: Copy this to config.json and adjust the values. All keys are optional — omit any to use the default shown.
_note_lifetime: Pause anything that has spent this much in total and produced zero results.
_note_daily: Pause campaigns that have spent this much TODAY with zero results today.
_note_levels: Which object levels to scan. Remove 'ad' or 'adset' to only check campaigns.
_note_result_types: Actions that count as a result. See README for the lead double-count warning before adding offsite_conversion.fb_pixel_lead. Add offsite_conversion.fb_pixel_custom:OrderFormPurchase for a custom event named OrderFormPurchase.
_note_protect: Items whose id or name contains any string in this list are never paused. Use partial name matches or exact numeric ids.
_note_min_age: Do not kill anything younger than this many hours. Useful for giving new ads a grace period during the learning phase.
